description: Defines the QuicSpdyClientStream class, which manages SPDY request and response handling over QUIC in the Chromium project. It includes methods for sending requests, processing headers, and handling data streams.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientStream
classes.description: Handles SPDY request sending and response aggregation over QUIC, including header parsing and data management.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with stream ID and session.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Overrides base method to parse and store initial headers.

methods.name: OnTrailingHeadersComplete
methods.description: Overrides base method to parse and store trailer headers.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Called when data is available on the stream.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Serializes headers and body, sends request, and returns bytes sent.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the response data as a string view.

methods.name: header_bytes_read
methods.description: Returns the number of header bytes read.

methods.name: header_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns the number of header bytes written.

methods.name: AreHeadersValid
methods.description: Validates headers received from the server.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateHeaders
methods.description: Copies and validates headers, extracting content length.

methods.name: ParseAndValidateStatusCode
methods.description: Parses and validates the response status code.
